changed.fact: ME->>TR: a trait-impl method / ME->>FO: an impl method whose type is outside the code (successive messages, no alt)
changed.original: METH --> TRAIT; METH --> FOREIGN (separate builders, one per kind of definition)
changed.why: The sequence draws both outcomes as happening one after the other in a single run. They are exclusive: impl_method_id returns method_id (the type-owned [Trait] form) only when the owner is global, and the module/impl anchor otherwise (ids.rs:102-110). No alt marks the choice, though the same rewrite uses one for this branch in EXT-02.3.
